raw.details:
Infriqa: Design. Build. Operate. Challenge

Build the Next Generation of AI Applications from Architecture to Production.

Most hackathons stop at a prototype. At Infriqa — The Agentic Cloud for AI Applications, we challenge you to experience the complete engineering lifecycle: designing scalable architecture, building functional software, deploying it to the cloud, and operating it in production.

  • Dates: November 30 – December 13, 2026 (2 Weeks)
  • Mode: Online (Virtual Via Unstop)
  • Team Size: Individual or up to 5 members
  • Eligibility: Students, developers, AI/cloud engineers, and tech enthusiasts

Event Format & Execution Platforms:

This hackathon is conducted 100% online across the following dedicated platforms:

  • Registrations, Team Formation & Submissions: Hosted directly on Unstop (all final deliverables—GitHub links, architecture diagrams, and demo videos—must be submitted via the Unstop submission portal).

  • Cloud Development, Deployment & Operations: Hosted on Infriqa ([https://infriqa.ai](https://infriqa.ai)), where participants will build, deploy, and monitor their AI applications alongside standard cloud/AI tooling of their choice.

  • Official Announcements & Support: Managed through Unstop announcements and email updates sent to registered participants.

Judging Criteria: The Three Pillars

  • Design (25%): Translate an idea into a scalable application and cloud architecture—defining agents, APIs, data pipelines, and infrastructure dependencies.

  • Build (30%): Turn your architecture into working software using modern AI engineering, backend development, and repeatable CI/CD deployments.

  • Operate (30%): Make it production-ready by demonstrating monitoring, diagnostics, cost/security optimization, and continuous alignment between your app and cloud infrastructure.

  • Innovation, Practical Value & Demo (15%): 10% for real-world usefulness and originality; 5% for clarity of presentation and walkthrough video.

What You Can Build:

Solve any real-world problem using AI. Popular tracks include:

  • Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems

  • AI-Powered SaaS & Developer Tools

  • AI Workflow & Process Automation

  • AI Infrastructure, Cloud & Data Engineering

Timeline & Deliverables:

  • Week 1 (Nov 30 – Dec 6): Problem definition, system architecture design, and core application development on Infriqa.

  • Week 2 (Dec 7 – Dec 13): Production cloud deployment, operational monitoring/optimization, and final project submission on Unstop.

Required Deliverables (Submitted on Unstop):

  • Clear problem statement and solution overview
  • System architecture diagrams
  • Working deployed application URL
  • Evidence of operational diagnostics and performance/cost improvements
  • Public source code repository (GitHub)
  • Walkthrough video demonstrating your Design → Build → Operate journey (highlighting how Infriqa and other tools were used)

Prizes & Perks:

  • 1st Prize: ₹5,000 cash + 3 months of free access to all OpenAI models + 1 year of Infriqa access.

  • 2nd Prize: 3 months of free access to all OpenAI models + 1 year of Infriqa access.

  • Internship Track: Top 10 eligible candidates will be fast-tracked for interviews for a paid 6-month internship (with potential full-time conversion).

  • All Participants: 6 months of free Infriqa access and exclusive stickers.

  • Builder Bonus: Top 5 participants logging 15+ hours building and operating receive Infriqa diaries.

Ready to go beyond prototypes? Register now on Unstop, fire up Infriqa, and ship a production-ready AI product!
